project_info.theme: kinetic city-crossing fashion portrait at blue hour
project_info.color_palette: cool navy, charcoal, neon magenta, taxi orange, and soft white sky

main_subject.detail: Adult subject in a long stone-colored trench coat crosses a busy downtown intersection, their coat hem moving in the wind and face kept softly shadowed.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical full-body urban fashion editorial at blue hour. An adult subject in a long stone-colored trench coat crosses a busy downtown intersection, with their coat hem moving in the wind and face kept softly shadowed. Surround them with tall glass-and-concrete buildings, a crosswalk, dense traffic, bright abstract billboards with no readable text, and controlled long-exposure streaks from taxis and headlights in orange, cyan, and white. Use cool ambient city light mixed with neon and vehicle spill, high-contrast silhouette, intentional slow-shutter motion blur, fine grain, and natural neon bloom. No readable text, logo, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, child, sexualized pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, accidental blur, duplicate person, extra limbs, deformed, readable text, logo, watermark
